assessment: This fundamental work advances our understanding of the function of a subpopulation of bone marrow cells as an important source of M-CSF to regulate bone remodeling. The evidence supporting the conclusion is compelling, using Adipoq-Cre-driven conditional deletion of Csf1 and the analysis of the publicly available scRNAseq data. This paper is of interest to skeletal biologists studying bone marrow stem/progenitor cells and bone remodeling.
